items.markdown:
Ambient noise is `the all-encompassing background sound present in a given environment` , separate from any specific sound you are trying to focus on.[[1]](https://www.safeopedia.com/definition/5568/ambient-noise)

### Types of Ambient Noise

- **Natural sounds:** Rain, ocean waves, wind, and birdsong.[[1]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=ipf7ifVSeDU)[[2]](https://www.noisli.com/)
- **Mechanical sounds:** Fans, air conditioners, and hums from electrical devices.[[1]](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Background_noise)
- **Urban and social sounds:** Traffic, distant chatter, or the murmur of a coffee shop.[[1]](https://asoftmurmur.com/)[[2]](https://www.bose.com/stories/what-is-ambient-noise)
- **Color noises:** White noise (equal energy across frequencies) and pink noise (stronger low-frequency energy).[[1]](https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=rlgK3VSn9SY)

### Effects and Uses

- **Sound masking:** Constant, predictable ambient noise helps block out sudden, disruptive spikes in noise pollution.[[1]](https://www.noisli.com/)
- **Focus and productivity:** Steady soundscapes from tools like [Noisli](https://www.noisli.com/) or generators like [A Soft Murmur](https://asoftmurmur.com/) can enhance concentration during work or study.[[1]](https://asoftmurmur.com/)[[2]](https://www.noisli.com/)
- **Sleep and relaxation:** Gentle background audio helps calm inner alertness and aids transition into deep rest.[[1]](https://mynoise.net/)[[2]](https://www.noisli.com/)
- **Health impacts:** Prolonged exposure to high ambient noise levels above 85 decibels can cause permanent hearing damage and elevate stress.[[1]](https://www.bose.com/stories/what-is-ambient-noise)

If you'd like, let me know if you are looking for ambient noise to help with **sleep, study, or blocking out a specific loud distraction** , and I can recommend a tailored sound type or generator.
